name: Octree-based Mesh Voxelization
aliases: Mesh to Sparse Voxel Octree Conversion
Octree-based Mesh Voxelization — Recursive Triangle Voxelization via Octree
definition: A technique to convert a triangle mesh into a voxel representation by recursively subdividing a 3D bounding box into an octree and marking leaf nodes that intersect with mesh triangles as active voxels.
summary: Octree-based mesh voxelization converts triangle meshes into sparse voxel grids by recursively subdividing space and marking nodes intersecting triangles, enabling efficient storage of large scenes.
